item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:

The Oleshky ceasefire is being exploited by Russian troops to move forces, and a Russian Su‑57 fighter was lost to an engine fire at Akhtubinsk airfield. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israeli security forces carried out mass arrests across the occupied West Bank and rooftop settlers in Hebron threatened the city’s Palestinian identity, prompting Palestinians to return to ruined homes after a ten-day siege.
